general: Two numbers matter more here than staying low in general: Ungoliant's Spawn engages at 32 and the Hummerhorns at 40. Every point you hold under those keeps the scenario's two worst enemies up in the staging area, where you can shoot them instead of fighting them.

Taking an attack undefended is how this encounter deck punishes you. Its worst shadow effects carry a second, harsher clause that fires only when the attack was undefended: Ungoliant's Spawn raises your threat by 8 instead of 4, and the Hummerhorns deal 2 damage to every character you control instead of 1.

The encounter deck holds exactly one Ungoliant's Spawn, and one of the two stage 3 cards is won only by finding and defeating it - a search of the encounter deck and the discard pile. Put it anywhere those two piles are not, the victory display included, and that stage has nothing left to find.

The Core Set's Tactics starter is the one pre-made deck that struggles here: it has the attack power for the spiders but almost no willpower to quest with, so it only wins when the encounter deck happens to deal it enemies. Merge it with another sphere before bringing it to this scenario.

1: Setup searches out one Forest Spider and puts it in the staging area before round one, so this scenario opens with combat already on the table. It engages at 25, and its Forced effect gives it +1 attack for the round once it does - a 3-attack enemy while you are still setting up. Have a defender ready.
2: Stage 2 asks for only 2 quest points, so you will clear it almost as soon as you arrive, ready or not. Spend the round you get thinning the staging area, because defeating this stage sends you to one of the two stage 3 cards at random - you do not choose, and they ask for very different things.
3: Both stage 3 cards end with Ungoliant's Spawn dead: "Don't Leave the Path!" is won by finding and defeating it, and Beorn's Path cannot be defeated while it is in play. So arrive with it already in play and already damaged - 9 hit points behind 2 defence is a long fight to be starting from full.
